lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form IV) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَأَغْطَشَ is in the derivative form: أغْطَشَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
غ/ط/ش   gh–ṭ–sh weak eye sight; (of night) to be dark, to cause to be dark; to be difficult; to travel through the land. Of this root, only أغْطَشَ ʾaghṭasha occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أغْطَشَ ʾaghṭasha [v. IV trans.] to make dark

(79:29) وَأَغْطَشَ‏ ‏لَيْلَهَا‏ ‏وَأَخْرَجَ‏ ‏ضُحَاهَا‏ giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness.
